note: Early path uses only closes through the checkpoint. Low-to-window and +10% recovery are outcomes. Not a sell rule.

continuous.note: Signed MAE is the lowest return through the checkpoint. Positive additional-decline depth is abs(min(0, MAE)). A negative depth correlation means a deeper early decline lines up with a lower later outcome.
